product_overview: An enterprise-grade accounting ERP module focused on secure, compliant core accounting operations, real-time BI dashboards, and AI-powered assistance. It supports Vietnamese Circular 200 accounting standards with robust role-based security, period management, master data handling, and comprehensive financial reporting.
core_goals: Automate core accounting operations like invoicing, AR/AP tracking, cash receipts/payments, with consistent automated general ledger posting.
Provide near real-time financial dashboards and BI metrics including AR/AP aging, cash flow trends, and revenue analysis with latency under 5 minutes.
Enable end-to-end statutory financial reporting compliant with Vietnamese Circular 200.
Implement AI-powered contextual Q&A with source citations and fallback on accounting data.
Minimize manual accounting work and errors through process automation, validations, and workflow controls.
Enforce strict security including role-based access control, immutable audit trails, and period locking to guarantee compliance and data integrity.
Deliver a modern, modular technical architecture with high maintainability, testing coverage, and CI/CD support.
Showcase a seamless user workflow integrating transaction entry, real-time reporting, and AI assistance in a demo ready ERP submodule.
key_features: Secure authentication with JWT and multi-role RBAC supporting Admin, Accountant, Chief Accountant, and CFO roles.
Company and fiscal period management with validation, period closing controls, and audit trails.
Complete Chart of Accounts management compliant with Circular 200 including CRUD, leaf-only posting enforcement, and mandatory dimension validations.
Voucher engine supporting draft and posted states, auto-generated voucher numbering, validations for balanced double-entry, and optional maker-checker approval workflows.
Master data management for customers, suppliers, and bank accounts supporting import, CRUD, and linkage to accounting transactions.
Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable modules with purchase bills, sales invoices, aging reports, payments, and approval workflows.
Cash and bank account management with real-time running balances and manual bank reconciliation via CSV upload.
Financial reporting suite with Trial Balance, Balance Sheet, Income Statement, Cash Flow Statement, F01 report export, drill-down capabilities, and CSV/PDF/Excel export formats.
Real-time BI Dashboard for key metrics with auto-refresh and multi-period comparison.
AI RAG Chatbot integrated with vector DB for context-aware Vietnamese language Q&A, source citations, and on-screen guidance.
Administrative features including user management, import/export utilities, notification center, and global search.
Enforced compliance with Circular 200, append-only audit logging, rigorous data validation, and immutable security policies.
user_flow_summary: User logs in securely, navigates dashboards displaying key metrics, and accesses modules based on role permissions.
Users manage master data including customers, suppliers, bank accounts, and company profile with validation.
Accountants create and post vouchers using intuitive editable grids which enforce balanced entries and TT200 validation rules.
AP and AR clerks enter bills/invoices, submit for approval if above thresholds, and record linked payments, with status updates reflecting in aging reports and BI dashboards.
Chief Accountant manages fiscal periods by performing pre-close validations, closing periods securely, and inspecting audit logs confirming actions.
Users generate statutory financial reports, drill down into voucher source data, and export for stakeholders.
Users interact with the AI chatbot for real-time accounting guidance, contextual help, and data-driven Q&A with traceability.
Administrators manage users, roles, system settings, and perform data imports/exports via guided interfaces.
validation_criteria: Authentication must enforce JWT with secure cookie sessions and strong hashing; unauthorized access results in proper HTTP errors.
RBAC enforced at API and UI layer; forbidden actions return 403 errors, UI elements hidden.
Period closing validates no drafts exist, balanced journals, and records audit log entry with user and timestamp.
Voucher entries must be balanced (Dr=Cr), only allow leaf accounts, and require mandatory dimensions as per rules.
Data imports reject invalid formats; exports produce accurate CSV/Excel according to templates.
Financial reports conform strictly to Circular 200 formats and map accounts correctly.
API responses meet performance targets: page loads under 2s, form submissions under 1s, report generation under 5s.
AI chatbot answers achieve ≥90% accuracy with citations, fallback if data incomplete, and respond relevantly to contextual queries.
All critical actions (posting, approvals, period close) append to immutable audit logs; no deletions/modifications allowed.
UI is fully localized in Vietnamese with correct formats; responsive for desktop and tablet resolutions; accessibility standards (AA) achieved.
Test coverage at least 60% for business logic; integration tests for key workflows passing in CI/CD pipelines.
Health check endpoint returns 200 OK for monitoring; monitoring enabled on slow queries, DB pool, and structured logging.
